title: 营收增43%：API暴涨8倍，AI需求藏不住
speaker: Mary Ann Sung

segments.en: Yes, we delivered a very strong set of results late last night.
segments.zh: 是的，我们昨晚发布了非常强劲的业绩。

segments.en: As you mentioned, Group Revenue Group 43% year on year.
segments.zh: 如您所说，集团营收同比增长43%。

segments.en: And we also delivered a significant milestone of both net profit and adjusted net profit.
segments.zh: 同时，我们在净利润和调整后净利润方面也实现了重要里程碑。

segments.en: That have solidified our growth into the long-term structural trend.
segments.zh: 这巩固了我们顺应长期结构性趋势的增长。

segments.en: Particularly, I would like to highlight the growth in our API, which is auto-convexory.
segments.zh: 尤其想强调我们API业务的增长，这是自动凸轮业务。

segments.en: We saw our revenue grew more than eight times.
segments.zh: 该业务营收增长了超过8倍。

segments.en: And also token demand surged close to six times or more year on year compared to first half last year.
segments.zh: 同时，Token需求同比激增近6倍甚至更多，相比去年上半年。
